sections.Profile:
The "Thing" pinball machine, manufactured by Chicago Coin Machine Co. in 1951, is known for its unique gameplay, featuring a "mystery score" area at the center of the playfield, representing the game's "thing" box.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1951
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Original Theme
